notes: 20 clubs, double round-robin, 38 rounds, 380 matches (season 14 Aug 2026 - 28 May 2027). Single row, so closed both ways; the second tier (Iraqi Premier Division League) is outside our data. 2026-27 is a one-off transition season: the bottom FOUR are relegated and only the top TWO of the Premier Division League come up, to cut the league to 18 clubs for 2027-28 (20 - 4 + 2 = 18). In a normal season it is 2 direct down + the 18th-placed club in a two-legged play-off against the winner of a play-out between the Premier Division League's 3rd and 4th, with 2 promoted. If a career sim is seeded past 2026-27 it must switch back to the 3-up/3-down play-off shape. Tiebreakers changed for 2026-27: goal difference is the first tiebreaker again (it had been head-to-head).
